jobs.title: Front-end Software Engineer (React/TypeScript)
jobs.description:
Company Description
Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies, and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts, and combines delivering results with enjoyment.
Job Description
Project – the aim you’ll have
Our client is a gaming company established to reform the national gaming system. Operating under the principle of exclusivity, its mission is to provide games responsibly, mitigate gambling-related risks, and ensure player protection while preventing fraud.
The company offers a wide range of games divided into three main categories: Lucky Games, Casino Games, and Betting Games. It emphasizes operating responsibly and contributing to a safe and secure gaming environment.
Role – How You’ll Contribute
Design, develop, and maintain modern frontend applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
Build user-friendly, responsive, and accessible web services for consumer customers.
Develop reusable and maintainable frontend components, following clean code principles and engineering best practices.
Implement state management and data-fetching solutions using Zustand and React Query / TanStack Query.
Integrate frontend applications with backend services using GraphQL.
Contribute to improving application performance, usability, and overall user experience.
Support internationalization and localization of web applications using i18next.
Participate in A/B testing activities to evaluate and improve user experience.
Write and maintain automated tests to ensure code quality and application reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Qualifications
Expectations – the experience you need
At least 3 years of full-time professional experience in web frontend development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
At least 4 years of professional experience with TypeScript.
At least 2 years of professional experience with React.
At least 1 year of experience developing web services for consumer customers.
Experience developing accessible web services and working with A/B testing.
Experience with Remeda, Zustand, GraphQL, React Query / TanStack Query, and i18next.
Experience with Node.js, GitLab, and pnpm.
Experience with Jest / Vitest and Cypress.
Additional Skills – The Edge You Have
Experience designing scalable and maintainable frontend architectures.
Experience optimizing web application performance and accessibility.
Familiarity with modern frontend development practices and tools.
Experience working in cross-functional Agile teams.
Additional Information
Role at: Software Mind Romania
What We Offer
Flexible and remote cooperation options
International projects with leading global clients
Travels related to international projects
Non-corporate atmosphere
Internal & external training
Well-being initiatives
#WORLD

jobs.description:
HCLTech
is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
We are looking for Frontend Developers to join our team!
Overview:
We oversee a high-frequency, low-latency Order and Execution Management system, supporting Private Bank business lines across multiple regions.
Job Requirements:
Frontend Tech Stack: Hands-on knowledge in developing Single Page Applications (SPAs) using Angular, and TypeScript. Strong experience in responsive design, web accessibility (a11y), and CSS3/SCSS (Bootstrap 4+).
Junit/ Unit Testing: Proven experience in consuming and developing Node.js REST services, as well as unit testing with Karma/Jasmine or Jest.
Strong analytical skills;
Desire and ability to learn, debug and investigate across complex system landscape;
Demonstrable SW Development experience;
Excellent analytical and communication skills, strong independence and initiative, ability to work in agile delivery teams;
In-depth understanding of software quality and maintainability, including participation in QA automation process;
Excellent communication skills in English.
Nice to have:
Experience with React framework
Experience with GitHub workflows
Knowledge of UX design and work with Figma
Why Us?
We are investing in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark;
We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility;
Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities;
We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe;
We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees;
We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 25 countries including Romania, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect;
What do we offer?
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.

In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer - DealWise @ING Hubs Romania
jobs.description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Here's a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:
At ING, we're building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agree
The Mission
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in web components and JavaScript frameworks to join our dynamic team. As a Frontend Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing user interfaces for our web applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in frontend development, a deep understanding of web technologies, and a passion for creating seamless and visually appealing user experiences.
Your day to day
Frontend Development & Web Components
Develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable frontend applications.
Build modular Web Components using technologies such as Lit and modern JavaScript frameworks.
Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces.
Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend standards.
Promote coding best practices, maintainability, and consistency across applications.
Microfrontend Architecture
Design, develop, and maintain solutions within a microfrontend architecture.
Ensure seamless integration between independently developed frontend applications.
Support modularization, scalability, and independent delivery of frontend capabilities.
Contribute to frontend architecture evolution and technical decision-making.
State Management
Implement and maintain scalable state management solutions using Redux or similar technologies.
Define effective patterns for data flow and asynchronous operations.
Ensure predictable application behavior and maintainable state structures.
Support communication across frontend modules and applications.
Accessibility & User Experience
Develop accessible user interfaces that comply with WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
Perform accessibility reviews and remediation activities.
Ensure compatibility with assistive technologies.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility best practices.
Performance Optimization
Optimize application performance and loading times.
Identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks, memory issues, and performance concerns.
Improve Core Web Vitals and overall user experience.
Continuously monitor and enhance frontend performance.
Testing & Quality Engineering
Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Support automated testing practices.
Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, quality validation, and deployment processes.
Manage source control, build pipelines, release workflows, and artifacts.
Support deployment and release activities across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot build and deployment issues and drive continuous improvement of delivery processes.
AI-Assisted Development
Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered engineering assistants to improve productivity.
Use AI-assisted development techniques for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Validate and review AI-generated outputs to ensure compliance with quality, security, and maintainability standards.
Contribute to the adoption of responsible AI-assisted development practices within the team.
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Collaborate with developers, architects, designers, product owners, and QA engineers.
Participate in architectural discussions and technical design reviews.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities and best practices.
Support junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring and technical guidance.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
What you'll bring to the team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience developing modern frontend applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Lit, React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
Strong experience building and maintaining Web Components.
Solid experience with Redux or similar state management solutions.
Experience working within microfrontend architectures.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
Experience implementing accessibility standards (WCAG, WAI-ARIA).
Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Adobe Analytics
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
If you have a passion for building innovative and user-friendly interfaces using the latest web technologies, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our web applications and providing users with exceptional digital experiences.
